# ROTP Read-Only Audit: Standalone Items, World Features & NPCs

Audit comparing original Forge (`src/`) against Fabric 1.21.4 port (`fabric/`). Stand actions and non-Stand power trees excluded.

---

## 1. Priority Systems Status

### 1. Blade Hat
* **Original Registrations**:
  * Item: `ModItems.BLADE_HAT` (`"blade_hat"`) → [`BladeHatItem`](file:///home/alanno/Documents/Soft/ROTP_port/src/main/java/com/github/standobyte/jojo/item/BladeHatItem.java)
  * Entity: `ModEntityTypes.BLADE_HAT` (`"blade_hat"`) → [`BladeHatEntity`](file:///home/alanno/Documents/Soft/ROTP_port/src/main/java/com/github/standobyte/jojo/entity/itemprojectile/BladeHatEntity.java)
  * Client: [`BladeHatRenderer`](file:///home/alanno/Documents/Soft/ROTP_port/src/main/java/com/github/standobyte/jojo/client/render/entity/renderer/itemprojectile/BladeHatRenderer.java), [`BladeHatArmorModel`](file:///home/alanno/Documents/Soft/ROTP_port/src/main/java/com/github/standobyte/jojo/client/render/armor/model/BladeHatArmorModel.java), [`BladeHatEntityModel`](file:///home/alanno/Documents/Soft/ROTP_port/src/main/java/com/github/standobyte/jojo/client/render/entity/model/projectile/BladeHatEntityModel.java), [`BladeHatSound`](file:///home/alanno/Documents/Soft/ROTP_port/src/main/java/com/github/standobyte/jojo/client/sound/BladeHatSound.java)
* **Key Method Anchors**:
  * `BladeHatItem.use()`: Spawn thrown hat entity when sneaked/thrown; wears as helmet otherwise.
  * `BladeHatEntity.tick()`: Flight trajectory, homing/returning logic, spinning sound.
  * `BladeHatEntity.onHitEntity()`: Slashing damage and blade ricochet.
* **Fabric Parity**: **Missing**. Zero traces in `fabric/`.

### 4. Paintings & Music / Discs / Cassettes
* **Paintings**:
  * Registrations: [`ModPaintings.MONA_LISA`](file:///home/alanno/Documents/Soft/ROTP_port/src/main/java/com/github/standobyte/jojo/init/ModPaintings.java#L16) (`"mona_lisa"`, 32×64), [`ModPaintings.MONA_LISA_HANDS`](file:///home/alanno/Documents/Soft/ROTP_port/src/main/java/com/github/standobyte/jojo/init/ModPaintings.java#L17) (`"hands"`, 16×16).
  * Fabric Parity: **Missing** (Needs 1.21.4 `PaintingVariant` datapack registry entries).
* **Music / Discs System**:
  * ROTP does *not* register standalone vanilla `RecordItem` discs. Instead, it uses custom Walkman & Cassette infrastructure:
    * `ModItems.WALKMAN` → [`WalkmanItem`](file:///home/alanno/Documents/Soft/ROTP_port/src/main/java/com/github/standobyte/jojo/item/WalkmanItem.java)
    * `ModItems.CASSETTE_BLANK` → [`CassetteBlankItem`](file:///home/alanno/Documents/Soft/ROTP_port/src/main/java/com/github/standobyte/jojo/item/CassetteBlankItem.java)
    * `ModItems.CASSETTE_RECORDED` → [`CassetteRecordedItem`](file:///home/alanno/Documents/Soft/ROTP_port/src/main/java/com/github/standobyte/jojo/item/CassetteRecordedItem.java)
    * Crafting: [`CassetteRecordingRecipe`](file:///home/alanno/Documents/Soft/ROTP_port/src/main/java/com/github/standobyte/jojo/crafting/CassetteRecordingRecipe.java) (records music from vanilla music discs into cassettes), [`CassetteCopyRecipe`](file:///home/alanno/Documents/Soft/ROTP_port/src/main/java/com/github/standobyte/jojo/crafting/CassetteCopyRecipe.java).
    * Audio/GUI: [`WalkmanScreen`](file:///home/alanno/Documents/Soft/ROTP_port/src/main/java/com/github/standobyte/jojo/client/ui/screen/walkman/WalkmanScreen.java), [`WalkmanItemContainer`](file:///home/alanno/Documents/Soft/ROTP_port/src/main/java/com/github/standobyte/jojo/container/WalkmanItemContainer.java), [`WalkmanTrackSound`](file:///home/alanno/Documents/Soft/ROTP_port/src/main/java/com/github/standobyte/jojo/client/sound/WalkmanTrackSound.java).
* **Fabric Parity**: **Missing**. Zero traces in `fabric/`.

## 3. Dormant / Deprecated / Stub Registrations

Separate these out—do **not** prioritize or port blindly:

1. **`___` (`___Entity`)**: Registry artifact (`ENTITIES.register("___", ...)`). Pure developer joke/stub. Ignore.
2. **`util_object` (`ObjectEntity`)**: Internal invisible positioning entity for cutscenes/physics. Defer until specific animation/cutscene demands it.
3. **`crazy_diamond_non_block_anchor` & `gold_experience_body_tissue`**: Stand action helper dummy items; owned by respective Stand agents.
4. **`boiling_blood` & `boiling_blood_bucket`**: Unfinished 1.16 fluid experiment. Dormant in primary gameplay loops.
5. **`magicians_red_fire`**: Specialized fire block owned by Magician's Red stand agent.
6. **`stand_remover`, `stand_eject`, `stand_full_clear`** (and `_one_time` variants): Creative / admin debugging tools. Port only after all Stand capabilities exist.

---

## 4. Concrete Dependency & Implementation Order

```
Phase 1: Zero-Dependency Standalone Items & Paintings
  ├─ Paintings (1.21.4 PaintingVariant data: mona_lisa, hands)
  ├─ Standalone Weapons & Armor:
  │    ├─ Blade Hat (Item + Projectile Entity + Model)
  │    └─ Tommy Gun (Item + Bullet Entity + Model)
  └─ Misc standalone items (squid_ink_pasta, cocoa_gum, nail_clippers, harpoon)

Phase 2: Worldgen & Mining Progression
  ├─ Blocks & Items: meteoric_ore, meteoric_iron, meteoric_scrap, meteoric_ingot
  ├─ Meteorite Crater Structure (1.21.4 Jigsaw/Structure template in cold biomes)
  └─ Pillarman Temple Structure (Jungle structure template)

Phase 3: Media & Audio System
  ├─ Walkman & Blank/Recorded Cassettes
  ├─ Cassette recording & copying recipes (Jukebox / Music disc bridge)
  └─ Walkman GUI Screen & container networking

Phase 4: Complex Entities & Pocket Dimension
  ├─ RPS Kid NPC (Mob entity + AI goals + RPS minigame GUI)
  └─ Coco Jumbo & Mr President:
       ├─ CocoJumboTurtleEntity + Key interaction
       ├─ Pocket Dimension / Feature generation
       └─ Teleport handlers (Key in -> Shell -> Gem out)
```
